name: @xinity/prism
description: Prism — OpenAI-compatible optimizing inference proxy. Self-Consistency, Best-of-N, PlanSearch, RTO, Memory (WiM), DeepConf, plus privacy/readurls/json plugins.
author: Xinity AI <hello@xinity.ai> (https://xinity.ai)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist --packages=external && bun build bin/prism.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/bin --packages=external && bun tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run scripts/fix-dts-extensions.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test tests/unit && bun run build
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
